column1: # Diet dish words (recipe-text/7): the words of recipe titles and methods that nearly always come with a class's food in the recipe's own lines, derived from the corpus (the read-only staging copy of 2026-11-26, 116,557 live recipes, read by Nom.Import --dish-words --no-statements), never listed by hand (DietDishWords).

# corpus: all, every live recipe; web, only the recipes a site publishes as structured data, whose lines are the author's whole list. recipes: those of the corpus whose title (or method) carries the word; flagged: those of them with a line the class's reference type flags. A word is kept for a class when, in either corpus, at least 20 recipes carry it and at least 0.95 of them are flagged (a method word only when it ends the titles of as many); a lost row (place lost) is a class at least 0.5 of the recipes that are the dish a lost part makes are flagged for (dough: the titles of a dish made in a dough; any other word: the titles that carry it).
